discription: A rich, warm pad sound generated by two slightly detuned sawtooth oscillators, shaped by a low-pass filter and a long ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, cutoff=4000, rq=0.5, attack=0.1, decay=0.8, sustain=0.6, release=2.0;    var sig, env;    env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    sig = Saw.ar(freq * [0.99, 1.01]) * 0.5;    sig = LPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq);    Out.ar(out, sig * amp * env ! 2);}
